method: UI in Claude in Chrome, the test account, pt-BR, on ZZ_TEST_segment_1 (ID 1).
steps_run: Segmentos > row menu (6 entries: Renomear, Duplicar, Mover segmento, Dividir em listas [crown], Atualizar dados, Excluir segmento)
Renomear: side panel 'Renomear segmento', field 'Novo nome do segmento*' (max 50): renamed to ZZ_TEST_segment_1_renamed (toast 'Segmento renomeado para ...', Última edição updated), then renamed back
Mover segmento: panel 'Mova segmento para outra pasta', select 'Pasta*' showed no other folder and a button 'Criar uma nova pasta'; cancelled

Duplicar: panel 'Duplicar segmento', 'Nome*' prefilled 'Duplicado de <name>' (max 50) and 'Pasta de destino*' (default My segments): created ZZ_TEST_segment_2_dup (toast 'Segmento ... duplicado', new ID 2, same filter, 1 contact)
Atualizar dados: clicked, no toast or visible change (count stayed 1)
not_executed: Excluir segmento (deletion not allowed in this test)
limitations: Request bodies and internal service hosts not captured for the segment actions.
